title: ZDX call-quality metrics per device and meeting

prose.text: Call quality comes from the meeting platforms rather than from probes, [[zdx.cloud-architecture:call-quality]], once a tenant is onboarded, [[zdx.applications:uc-tenant-onboarding]]. {{cqm-read}}

prose.label: Open.
prose.text: Which applications populate this read and which metric names appear in its series are not enumerated {{gap:cqm-scope}}. How each SDK types the metrics is in [[zdx.sdk-python.response-models]].

checks.do: Whether the application is a call-quality (CQM) application with its tenant onboarded before expecting meeting data.

cqm-read.statement: The call-quality read returns the Call Quality metric trend for a device for a CQM application, for the last 2 hours if no time range is given.

expect.description: Gets the Call Quality metric trend for a device for a CQM application. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours.

meeting-fields.statement: Each entry is a meeting, with its meeting ID, meeting session ID and subject, and a `metrics` array of series.

cqm-scope.title: Which applications have call-quality data and which metrics it carries
cqm-scope.detail: The contract says the read is for a CQM application; the help names Microsoft Teams, Webex and Zoom call-quality onboarding and the architecture page Microsoft Graph and Zoom. Which applications populate the read and which metric labels appear in its series are not enumerated.
cqm-scope.blocks: call-quality answers for a given application
